repository_card.frontier: The v2 series distinguishes conditional reattachment from Petz recovery, explicit maintenance baselines and Davies-locality limitations.
repository_card.bridge_hypothesis: Place no-disentangler quantifiers beside the code-restricted recovery claim, and collision-model work beside the battery-accounted maintenance theorem. Universal state coverage is lost when restricting to a code; physical reset resources are lost when a bath map is treated as free.
repository_card.next_finite_task: Write the input class, reference system, channel uniformity and trace-distance error in one table. For a two-qubit collision cycle compute system, ancilla and reset work separately before comparing with the maintenance bound.
repository_card.falsifier: Reject any contradiction with no-disentanglers unless universal coverage holds. Reject a power-floor comparison if ancilla resetting or the baseline-achievability assumption is omitted.
repository_card.proposal_status: speculative; not executed or formally verified

sources.title: A quantum oracle separation between QMA(2) and QMA
sources.publication_status: preprint; peer-review status not established in this sweep
sources.source_claim: Bostanci and collaborators report a quantum-oracle separation of QMA(2) from QMA and derive exponential input-size requirements for approximate disentanglers with total error below one.
sources.limits: Oracle separation is not an unrelativized class separation. Universal coverage of separable states is much stronger than recovery of one reference state or a restricted code. First posted 2 September.

sources.title: Semidefinite extension complexity of the separable set, with applications to approximate disentanglers
sources.publication_status: preprint; peer-review status not established in this sweep
sources.review_depth: v1: introduction, Theorem 1.1, Corollary 1.2, Section 3 and formalization links
sources.source_claim: Gharibian, Hecht and Rudolph give dimension- and accuracy-dependent lower bounds for semidefinite representations of separable-state optimization in the HNW model. The paper links a companion Lean development.
sources.limits: The common feasible region and objective-independent embedding are essential. This is not a lower bound for every SDP or for unrestricted SAT circuits. The paper credits a stronger concurrent disentangler result to Bostanci et al.; its SDP result has a distinct scope. External Lean proofs were not rebuilt here.

sources.title: Ancilla mediated steady-state engineering in open quantum systems
sources.publication_status: preprint; peer-review status not established in this sweep
sources.source_claim: An NV-centre ancilla experiment implements collision-model reservoir engineering, including anti-thermalization and a steady-state quantum battery. Work, heat and coherence are tracked per collision.
sources.limits: Pulsed interactions and ancilla resets need not define the same fixed additive GKLS control class. A mixed steady-state battery is not exact maintenance of a rank-deficient target at zero reset cost.

sources.title: Work Extraction Across a Thermodynamic Hierarchy in Quantum Many-Body Systems
sources.publication_status: preprint; peer-review status not established in this sweep
sources.source_claim: Hokkyo and Ueda formulate a hierarchy of allowed operations for work extraction and bound additional work through differences of entropy densities or mutual-information density.
sources.limits: An extraction advantage is not an achievable maintenance-power baseline. Specify spatial access, control duration and connectivity. First posted 31 August.
